concept.concept: Chalkboard-style illustration of an apple, ruler, and pencil border around the text 'First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching'
concept.rationale: Teacher mugs are a perennial bestseller and the back-to-school gifting season peaks exactly in this buying window. Coffee humor is the top-performing concept in teacher mugs. High conversion as both self-purchase and parent/student gift.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a chalkboard-style design for a mug. Center composition features a bold outlined apple, wooden ruler, and sharpened pencil arranged in a simple rectangular border frame. All elements have clean, crisp edges with a hand-drawn chalkboard aesthetic using solid color blocks. Color palette: cream, charcoal gray, apple red, and natural wood tan. No gradients, no shading, no texture. The border elements create a frame around negative space for text. Plain cream solid background, distinct from all artwork colors. All elements centered and away from edges, readable at small scale.
design.text_on_design: First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching
design.style: Flat vector illustration, bold chalkboard aesthetic, screen-print ready, solid color blocks, clean sharp edges, high contrast, limited 4-color palette (cream, charcoal, red, tan)

verdict.reason: The phrase 'First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching' is a common generic humor sentiment widely used in the teacher gift market with no known trademark protection. The chalkboard aesthetic with apple, ruler, and pencil imagery is a generic educational motif. No celebrity references, brand names, or protected intellectual property detected. The phrase structure follows a well-established humorous template common to novelty items and does not appear to be a distinctive protected slogan.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching' with correct spelling and complete text. The artwork features generic teacher-themed elements (apple, ruler, pencils) with no IP, trademark, or quality concerns. Clean composition suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: First I Drink Coffee Then I Teach - Teacher Appreciation Mug
listing.description: Start the school day right with this witty teacher mug featuring chalkboard-style illustrations of apples, rulers, and pencils framing the text 'First I Drink the Coffee, Then I Do the Teaching.' The relatable message resonates with educators managing classrooms all day. Ideal back-to-school gift for elementary and middle school teachers. Ceramic construction keeps coffee hot while adding personality to any classroom desk.
